words.enExample: The design team decided to collaborate with the marketing department on the new campaign.
words.zhExample: 设计团队决定与营销部门合作开展新活动。
words.note: col-（共同）+ labor（劳动）+ -ate → 一起劳动 = 合作。名词 collaboration，形容词 collaborative。

words.enExample: We are working against a tight deadline, so everyone needs to stay focused.
words.zhExample: 我们正面临紧迫的截止日期，所以每个人都需要保持专注。
words.note: dead（死）+ line（线）→ 过了这条线就“死”了 = 截止线。职场高频：meet the deadline / miss the deadline。

words.meaning: 灵活的；可变通的；易弯曲的
words.enExample: A flexible schedule allows employees to balance work and personal life more effectively.
words.zhExample: 灵活的工作时间安排让员工能更有效地平衡工作与生活。
words.note: flex（弯曲）+ -ible（能够）→ 能够弯曲的 = 灵活的。反义词 inflexible。搭配 flexible hours / flexible approach。

words.enExample: It took three rounds of meetings to negotiate a fair contract with the supplier.
words.zhExample: 与供应商谈判达成一份公平合同花了三轮会议。
words.note: neg-（不）+ otium（闲暇）→ 没有闲暇 = 忙于交涉。名词 negotiation。搭配 negotiate a deal / salary negotiation。

words.meaning: 确定优先顺序；优先处理
words.enExample: When everything seems urgent, you need to prioritize tasks based on impact and effort.
words.zhExample: 当所有事看起来都很紧急时，你需要根据影响力和投入度来确定任务的优先顺序。
words.note: priority（优先）+ -ize（使……化）→ 使……优先。名词 prioritization。职场核心技能： Eisenhower Matrix（艾森豪威尔矩阵）。

essay.title: The Art of Being Alone
essay.author: 佚名
paragraphs: There is a kind of quiet that does not arrive until you stop filling the room with noise. Solitude is not the absence of company; it is the presence of yourself. In the hush of an early morning, before the world wakes and asks anything of you, you can hear the small, honest voice that is usually drowned out by the day.

We have been taught to fear being alone, as if emptiness were a failure. But an empty page is also a beginning. When no one is watching, you are free to be clumsy, to change your mind, to laugh at your own absurd thoughts without apology. The self that grows in solitude is not a lonely self; it is a rooted one.

To be alone well is a skill, and like any skill it asks for practice. Begin with ten minutes and a window. Watch light move across the floor. Notice that you are not bored but simply unhurried. Gradually the silence stops feeling like a void and starts feeling like a room you have furnished with your own attention.

In the end, solitude prepares us to meet others. The person who has learned to be at home with themselves brings something rare into a relationship: the gift of presence, undistracted and whole. To be alone, then, is not to retreat from the world but to return to it more fully.
translations: 有一种安静，要等你不再用噪音填满房间，它才会出现。独处不是没有陪伴，而是你自己就在此刻。在清晨的寂静里，在世界醒来、尚未向你索求什么之前，你能听见那个细小而真诚的声音——它平日总被白昼的喧闹淹没。
我们从小被教导要害怕独处，仿佛空荡是一种失败。可一张空白的纸，同样也是一个开始。当没有人注视，你可以笨拙，可以改主意，可以毫无歉意地笑自己那些荒唐的念头。在独处中生长出来的自我，不是一个孤独的自我，而是一个有根的自我。
好好独处是一门本事，而像所有本事一样，它需要练习。从十分钟和一扇窗开始。看光在地板上移动。你会发现自己并非无聊，只是不再匆忙。渐渐地，寂静不再像一处空洞，而开始像一个房间——一个你用自己的专注布置过的房间。
说到底，独处是为了让我们更好地与人相遇。一个学会在自己身上安家的人，会在关系里带来一种稀有的东西：那份全然专注、不被打断的"在场"的礼物。所以，独处并非从世界退场，而是更完整地回到其中。

grammar.point: not...but... 并列结构与对比强调
grammar.example: "Solitude is not the absence of company; it is the presence of yourself."
grammar.note: not A but B 是固定并列结构，否定前者、肯定后者，前后成分需对称（均为 the + 名词短语）。分号连接两个并列分句，形成"不是……而是……"的鲜明对照，突出 solitude 的实质是"自我在场"而非"无人陪伴"。 举一反三：写作中可用 not...but... 制造张力，如 It is not a weakness but a wisdom.（这不是软弱，而是智慧。）

grammar.point: as if 引导的虚拟语气（与现在事实相反）
grammar.example: "We have been taught to fear being alone, as if emptiness were a failure."
grammar.note: as if 意为"仿佛、好像"，其后接从句时用虚拟语气表示与事实不符的假设。本句讲述现实中的心理（emptiness 并非真的失败），故用 be 动词的过去式 were，而非 is，体现"虚拟"。主语为单数时用 were 是虚拟语气的规范用法。 举一反三：He talks as if he knew everything.（他说得好像什么都知道——其实并不知道。）

grammar.point: 动词不定式作主语与表语（前后对等）
grammar.example: "To be alone well is a skill." ／ "To be alone, then, is not to retreat from the world but to return to it more fully."
grammar.note: 两句均以不定式短语（To be alone well / To be alone）作主语，第二句以不定式 to retreat 与 to return 作表语，主语与表语同为不定式，结构对称、语气连贯。not to retreat...but to return 再次套用 not A but B 的并列，强调独处的真正意义。 举一反三：不定式作主语常表"一件具体的事"，谓语用单数；To learn is to grow.（学习即成长。）

grammar.point: 省略关系代词的定语从句 + who 引导的定语从句
grammar.example: "...a room you have furnished with your own attention." ／ "The person who has learned to be at home with themselves..."
grammar.note: 第一处 a room 后省略了关系代词 that/which，直接用 you have furnished 作定语从句修饰 room，口语与文学写作中常见；第二处 who 引导定语从句修饰 the person，who 在从句中作主语不可省略。两处都说明了"被修饰对象"的具体特征。 举一反三：关系代词在从句中作宾语时可省（the book you read），作主语时不可省（the man who called）。

vocab.enExample: She went to the cabin to enjoy a week of solitude.
vocab.zhExample: 她去小屋享受了一周的独处时光。
vocab.note: 用法：指独自一人的状态，常带正面或沉思意味；in solitude 独自地。

vocab.enExample: The absence of noise made the forest feel sacred.
vocab.zhExample: 没有噪音，让这片森林显得格外神圣。
vocab.note: 用法：the absence of 表示某物的缺乏；in the absence of 在……不在场时。

vocab.enExample: A hush settled on the room as the music began.
vocab.zhExample: 音乐响起时，房间里一片寂静。
vocab.note: 用法：指突然或深沉的安静；a hush fell over 一片寂静降临。

vocab.enExample: His gentle voice was drowned out by the storm.
vocab.zhExample: 他轻柔的声音被暴风雨盖过了。
vocab.note: 用法：指更大的声音盖住另一声音；被动 be drowned out by。

vocab.enExample: It is fine to be clumsy when you are learning alone.
vocab.zhExample: 独自学习时，笨拙一点也没关系。
vocab.note: 用法：形容动作不灵活，也可指表达生硬；a clumsy apology 笨拙的道歉。

vocab.enExample: She laughed at her own absurd little worries.
vocab.zhExample: 她笑自己那些荒唐的小烦恼。
vocab.note: 用法：指不合情理、可笑的；an absurd idea 荒唐的想法。

vocab.enExample: A rooted self is calmer in the face of change.
vocab.zhExample: 有根的自我，面对变化更从容。
vocab.note: 用法：源于 root（根），形容稳固、有根基；well rooted 扎根很深。

vocab.enExample: He spoke in an unhurried, thoughtful way.
vocab.zhExample: 他说话从容不迫，若有所思。
vocab.note: 用法：un- 否定前缀加 hurried，形容节奏舒缓；an unhurried pace 从容的步调。

vocab.enExample: The silence was not a void but a quiet room.
vocab.zhExample: 那片寂静不是空洞，而是一间安静的屋子。
vocab.note: 用法：指空无一物的空间或内心的空洞感；a void in one's heart 心里的空缺。

vocab.enExample: We furnished the room with books and light.
vocab.zhExample: 我们用书和光，把房间布置起来。
vocab.note: 用法：指为房间配家具，也比喻用某物充实；furnish with 用……布置。

vocab.enExample: Her calm presence comforted everyone in the room.
vocab.zhExample: 她沉静的在场，安抚了屋里所有人。
vocab.note: 用法：指人在现场的状态，也指气场；the gift of presence 全然在场的陪伴。

vocab.enExample: To rest is not to retreat but to gather strength.
vocab.zhExample: 休息不是退却，而是积蓄力量。
vocab.note: 用法：指后退、躲避；retreat from 从……退离；名词可作静修。

vocab.enExample: Give the moment your undistracted attention.
vocab.zhExample: 把全神贯注的注意力，交给此刻。
vocab.note: 用法：un- 否定加 distracted（分心的）；形容全神贯注。
